range: Recommendation feeds and any page that publishes twelve articles an hour.
field_marks: Written by no one, read by millions

confused_with.tell: The algodemic believes the nonsense; the slopagandist bills for it.

senses: An operator who mass-produces synthetic outrage - AI-written screeds, generated mugshots, bot-farmed replies - flooding the zone faster than any fact-checker can respond.
Someone who no longer needs a coherent ideology, only a reliable pipeline: outrage in, engagement out, truth an irrelevant byproduct of the machinery.
example: *"Twelve accounts, one prompt, four hundred posts a day - the **slopagandist** doesn't believe the story, he just ships it."*
